test_AttrDict_immutability: test the AttrDict class immutability feature to lock nested config values recursively
test_merge_cfg_from_cfg: test merging one config object into another using merge_cfg_from_cfg with valid and invalid keys
test_merge_cfg_from_file: test loading and merging config values from a YAML file into the global cfg object
test_merge_cfg_from_list: test merging config options from a flat key-value list into the global cfg object
test_deprecated_and_renamed_keys: test that deprecated and renamed config keys are ignored or raise errors during merge
